$note: Pricing + quota as DATA (T11.1) — the ONE table consumed by the estimate engine, the quota evaluator (T11.5), and the invoice generator (T11.3). A second pricing constant anywhere is a bug (billing pack). Money is integer cents (ADR-025). Sources: billing pack (F9) + ADR-041 (Pro $29 canonical; Jobs/Search/Vector are included DB capabilities within allowances). Plan fees reproduce canon (Business $99 = 9900). project_limit: -1 = unlimited. Enterprise fee is custom (null = negotiated, never a hard-coded number).

overage.$note: Soft-quota unit prices (billing pack). Plan-independent; charged beyond the plan's included allowance, only with confirm=true + shown price.

never_gated.$note: Plans gate capabilities, never safety (billing pack / F9). This list is law — a table-driven test asserts none of these is ever plan-checked.
